newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Bhutto calls new Pakistan budget "shocking".
newsitem.headline: Bhutto calls new Pakistan budget "shocking".

text.p: Pakistani opposition leader Benazir Bhutto on Friday blasted the government's new budget, saying it was designed to benefit foreign investors at the expense of local industry and consumers.
"This is a budget of disinformation and deceit, this is shocking," she told reporters soon after Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz unveiled the budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July/June).
Aziz said the budget would stimulate the ailing economy and control chronic deficit.

"In Pakistan's history, such a deceitful budget has never been brought," declared Bhutto, whose government was dismissed by President Farooq Leghari in November on disputed charges of corruption and misrule.
